t: Sandtex 10Ltr Ultra Smooth Magnolia Masonry Paint provides a high-quality, extra-durable finish for exterior surfaces. This water-based formula incorporates microseal technology, offering superior weather protection and excellent dirt resistance, ensuring walls remain clean. Designed for easy application by brush, roller, or spray, it delivers significant coverage of 12-16 m²/Ltr. Ideal for revitalising concrete, render, stone, and pebble-dash, this masonry paint is touch-dry in 3-4 hours and recoatable rapidly. Its breathable and waterproof finish ensures lasting protection for outdoor property, even when applied in temperatures above 8°C.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
